anchors.code_excerpt:
scope Deadline:
  date round down
  definition due equals start + (months * 1 month)
  definition late equals assessed > due
anchors.quote: The due date is start plus months calendar months. If the original day is absent from the target month, use the last day of the target month. months is a nonnegative integer. late is true exactly when assessed is after due; being assessed on due is not late.

assumptions: The host validates that months is nonnegative before evaluation; negative values are outside the permitted input domain.
Calendar months are added in one operation, preserving the original day when possible and otherwise rounding down to the target month's last day.
candidate.interpretation: Compute due by adding months calendar months to start with last-day rounding. Compute late using a strict date comparison; assessment on due is not late.
